notes: Older SleepStyle 200 series CPAP with built-in humidifier, models HC244 and HC242.

gaps: The manual names no external power brick.
No FCC ID, teardown or board-level source was found, so the blower, sensors and boards are undocumented.
method: Source is the Fisher & Paykel operating manual, document 185045254 Rev B (2011-04), read as text from the maker's PDF on 2026-11-12.
Models HC244 and HC242 share one manual.
The manual gives the device's mains supply rating (the power cord plugs into the rear of the device) and a DC-to-AC inverter requirement.

comps.spec: Humidifier heater plate rated 85 W max, plate temperature 65 C max; heater output is adjusted automatically by Ambient Tracking Plus

Mains-powered through a power cord and connector on the device: 100-115 V 1.2 A / 1.3 A or 220-240 V 0.8 A / 1.8 A (average current), 50-60 Hz; DC-to-AC inverter requirement 200 W (300 W surge) at 115 V or 300 W (500 W surge) at 230 V
Breathing tube, accessory part 900HC221; the connector is a separate accessory, part 900HC010
Air filter, accessory part 900HC240, held in a filter holder at the back of the device

sources.title: SleepStyle 200 Series CPAP Humidifier HC244/HC242 operating manual, Fisher & Paykel Healthcare doc 185045254 Rev B, 2011-04 (maker's PDF)
